writing.exampleCaption: Nothing happens until the future is awaited or spawned.
writing.explanation: Calling an async fn does nothing on its own: it builds a state machine that makes progress only when polled. .await yields at that point, letting the executor run something else while the operation is pending — which is how one thread can service thousands of waits.
